Step (b), `$.steps[1]` with those same fields, records scorer clone/commit exit 0 and push exit 128 classified `write-denied`; both satisfy the required allow/deny operations.

Actual acquisition is complete, all five positive controls hit (`1/1/1/1/1`), and tree/history/issues-comments/logs/artifacts each have zero sentinel hits. Workflow `dj()` uses `jq -r '.. | strings'` for both API responses; the issue control passes through JSON serialization and the same decoder/search, closing #366 F1.
6. Chronology independently checked through public Actions API metadata: workflow installation committed at 2026-11-08T11:23:12Z; [initial run 42480130998](https://github.com/Kucze3205/ConnectWithLabview/actions/runs/42480130998) started 12:24:50Z and completed 12:25:31Z; [revoked run 42480355765](https://github.com/Kucze3205/ConnectWithLabview/actions/runs/42480355765) started 12:27:38Z. 7. Redaction inspection of the entire record found no token value, sentinel marker value, private repository address or withheld contents. Count-only scans found zero GitHub token patterns, credential URLs or other GitHub repository URLs; the only URLs are the two public readiness runs. Secret continuity and deletion remain explicitly owner-attested in `$.notes`; private values and underlying run artifacts were not accessed.
8. Required `python3 -I -B policy/evaluator/evaluate.py --check` passed, exit 0: 72 evidence references, no errors or missing files. It reports benchmark_executed=false, benchmark_ready=false and tool_quality=null; it does not independently validate readiness content.

Recommendation: the Policymaker may use this independent executed-record acceptance for synthetic split allocation planning under capability #268. This review establishes the scoped store-readiness verdict, not benchmark quality or goal completion; no correction is required.
